name: Trello
description: Typed Trello boards, lists, cards, checklists, check items, labels, members, comments, attachment metadata, custom fields and organizations.

permissions.description: Fixed HTTPS api.trello.com/1 with external Trello API key and authorized user token in OAuth-style header. Provider read/write/account scopes and memberships apply. No account authorization flow, refresh, file transfer, persistent listeners or external attachment URL requests.

definitions.documentation: POST https://api.trello.com/1/cards. External Trello API key plus user token; Authorization OAuth oauth_consumer_key and oauth_token. Uses exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken, or named TRELLO_API_KEY and TRELLO_USER_TOKEN secrets (apiKeySecret/tokenSecret overrides). Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="TRELLO CREATE-CARD", $retries=0. One explicit bounded request; no retries, token exchange, refresh, attachment downloads, webhooks or persistent listeners. IDs are exact restricted strings; fixed origin and route/query/body validated before credentials. Known response fields projected to named resource schemas. Null, absent, false, zero, empty text and array order stay distinct; floating/unsafe JSON number tokens return exact decimal text, reusable for position queries or JSON body positions. Empty mutation result is a sanitized success object only. Lists are bounded to 1000 (card actions50); caller explicitly supplies next page/before/since only on documented action routes, no auto-pagination or automatic URL following. Limits: 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline begins before profiles/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, sync decoding and final return; strict UTF8/UTF16, nonblocking cleanup. definitions.name: Trello Update Card
definitions.documentation: PUT https://api.trello.com/1/cards/{cardId}. External Trello API key plus user token; Authorization OAuth oauth_consumer_key and oauth_token. Uses exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken, or named TRELLO_API_KEY and TRELLO_USER_TOKEN secrets (apiKeySecret/tokenSecret overrides). Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="TRELLO UPDATE-CARD", $retries=0. One explicit bounded request; no retries, token exchange, refresh, attachment downloads, webhooks or persistent listeners. IDs are exact restricted strings; fixed origin and route/query/body validated before credentials. Known response fields projected to named resource schemas. Null, absent, false, zero, empty text and array order stay distinct; floating/unsafe JSON number tokens return exact decimal text, reusable for position queries or JSON body positions. Empty mutation result is a sanitized success object only. definitions.documentation: PUT https://api.trello.com/1/cards/{cardId}/checkItem/{checkItemId}. External Trello API key plus user token; Authorization OAuth oauth_consumer_key and oauth_token. Uses exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.apiKey/accessToken, or named TRELLO_API_KEY and TRELLO_USER_TOKEN secrets (apiKeySecret/tokenSecret overrides). Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="TRELLO UPDATE-CHECK-ITEM", $retries=0. One explicit bounded request; no retries, token exchange, refresh, attachment downloads, webhooks or persistent listeners. IDs are exact restricted strings; fixed origin and route/query/body validated before credentials. Known response fields projected to named resource schemas. Null, absent, false, zero, empty text and array order stay distinct; floating/unsafe JSON number tokens return exact decimal text, reusable for position queries or JSON body positions. Empty mutation result is a sanitized success object only. Lists are bounded to 1000 (card actions50); caller explicitly supplies next page/before/since only on documented action routes, no auto-pagination or automatic URL following.
